question: What is the term of the Northwind and Bluefield NDA now?
answer:
The NDA’s current term is **four years from 1 March 2026**, so it runs to **1 March 2030**. The 1 September 2026 amendment replaced the original three-year term in clause 4.1; it left the other terms unchanged. [Amendment No 1 to the NDA.pdf, clauses 2.1 and 3.1, p1](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Amendment%20No%201%20to%20the%20NDA.pdf#page=1) [Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement.pdf, date and clause 4.1, pp1–2](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Mutual%20Non-Disclosure%20Agreement.pdf#page=2)

The confidentiality obligations in clause 2 survive termination for **five years**. [Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement.pdf, clause 4.2, p2](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Mutual%20Non-Disclosure%20Agreement.pdf#page=2)

**Sources**
- [Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement.pdf](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Mutual%20Non-Disclosure%20Agreement.pdf#page=2) — original term and survival clause.
- [Amendment No 1 to the NDA.pdf](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Amendment%20No%201%20to%20the%20NDA.pdf#page=1) — extended term and continuation of other terms.

question: What rent is payable now under the Harbour Street lease?
answer:
The rent payable now is **£56,000 per year**, effective 1 April 2025 under the [Rent Review Memorandum 2025.pdf, clause 1.2, p1](library/Harbour%20Street%20Lease/Rent%20Review%20Memorandum%202025.pdf#page=1). It remains payable in **equal quarterly payments in advance**—£14,000 each quarter—under the [Lease of Unit 4 Harbour Street.pdf, clause 3.1, p1](library/Harbour%20Street%20Lease/Lease%20of%20Unit%204%20Harbour%20Street.pdf#page=1). The [Side Letter on Rent.docx, clause 1.1, p1](library/Harbour%20Street%20Lease/Side%20Letter%20on%20Rent.docx#page=1) waived rent only for the first three months of the term.

question: Is the January 2024 Acme services agreement still in force?
answer:
No. The January 2024 services agreement **terminated on 1 March 2025** and ceased to have effect. The parties entered into a new services agreement that day; a later deed novated that **2025 agreement**, not the 2024 one. [Termination Agreement.pdf, clauses 1.1 and 2.1, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Termination%20Agreement.pdf#page=1) [Deed of Novation.pdf, clauses 1.1–1.2, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Deed%20of%20Novation.pdf#page=1)

**Sources**
- [Services Agreement 2024.pdf, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Services%20Agreement%202024.pdf#page=1) — identifies the 1 January 2024 agreement.
- [Termination Agreement.pdf, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Termination%20Agreement.pdf#page=1) — ends it on 1 March 2025.
- [New Services Agreement.pdf, pp1–2](library/Acme%20Services/New%20Services%20Agreement.pdf#page=1) — the replacement agreement dated 1 March 2025.
- [Deed of Novation.pdf, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Deed%20of%20Novation.pdf#page=1) — novates the 2025 agreement.

question: Who is the supplier under the Acme services agreement now?
answer:
**Acme Holdings GmbH** is the supplier now. The 1 March 2025 Services Agreement originally named Acme Services Limited as supplier, but the Deed of Novation dated 1 June 2025 transferred that agreement to Acme Holdings GmbH with effect from that date; the agreement otherwise continues on its terms. [New Services Agreement.pdf, p1](library/Acme%20Services/New%20Services%20Agreement.pdf#page=1) [Deed of Novation.pdf, clause 1, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Deed%20of%20Novation.pdf#page=1)

question: When must unpaid fees under the terminated 2024 Acme agreement be paid?
answer:
Unpaid fees under the 2024 Acme agreement must be paid **within 30 days of 1 March 2025**, the date it was terminated. [Termination Agreement.pdf, clauses 1.1–1.2, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Termination%20Agreement.pdf#page=1)

question: Across the whole library, which agreements are governed by German law?
answer:
**One agreement is governed by German law:** [New Services Agreement.pdf, clause 4.1, p2](library/Acme%20Services/New%20Services%20Agreement.pdf#page=2), dated 1 March 2025. The later [Deed of Novation.pdf, clauses 1.1–1.2, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Deed%20of%20Novation.pdf#page=1), dated 1 June 2025, changes the supplier but continues the agreement on its existing terms.

The agreements in the other two folders are governed by the laws of England and Wales: the [Lease of Unit 4 Harbour Street.pdf, clause 6.1, p2](library/Harbour%20Street%20Lease/Lease%20of%20Unit%204%20Harbour%20Street.pdf#page=2) and the [Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement.pdf, clause 5.1, p2](library/Northwind%20-%20Bluefield%20NDA/Mutual%20Non-Disclosure%20Agreement.pdf#page=2). The earlier [Services Agreement 2024.pdf, clause 3.1, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Services%20Agreement%202024.pdf#page=1) was also governed by the laws of England and Wales; it was ended by the [Termination Agreement.pdf, clause 1.1, p1](library/Acme%20Services/Termination%20Agreement.pdf#page=1).
